notes.title: v1.2.0 (March 29 2025)
notes.content:
It's been a while. Sorry for the late replies and updates in the discussions page. We recently introduced our second child to the world, and it's been quite the show.

Changes

 Native controller support
 Option to disable head bob motion
 Option to hide in-game timer after finishing the game once
 Increased max FOV to 120
 Some prep work and house cleaning needed for the new map


Thanks again to everyone who gave the game a chance and continue to speed run it.

notes.title: v1.1.2 (Jan 28 2025)
notes.content:
Added

 Look invert option

Changed

 Behavior of traffic lights' start timing. Start timing is now fixed.

Removed

 Fake pipes near second intersection


We realized that the random start timer for traffic lights had no real impact on a new player's understanding of the game. However the random start time hindered the runs of speedrun players with no actual measurement of skill. Rather than having to look down the street, and "time the red or green pixel" for the timing of the traffic light, the traffic light will just start as soon as the player starts moving.

notes.title: v1.0.1 update (1/3/2025)
notes.content:
We noticed some players were just barely escaping death during some sequences. This would cause the player to get stuck, as the game already expects the player to be eliminated.

We had two options: either tighten up the sequences to confirm the elimination of the player, or reward the player for "defeating" our elimination sequence.

We went with the reward instead. Going forward, if you just barely avoid death, instead of being stuck:


 You will be able to move again after a few seconds
 Unlock an achievement


Thanks for playing!
